name: Recovery Lab
description: Compose and cross-port custom recoveries. Builds GearLock- and OrangeFox-style trees from a device profile, checks that the upstream source layout matches what the build recipe expects, and produces the port patches needed to move one device's recovery environment to another device tree.

panels.title: Recovery Lab
panels.subtitle: GearLock / OrangeFox compose, env cross-port, upstream source matching
